plainText:
Elma (Japanese: エルマ Elma) is a minor recurring character in . She is a Pokémon Performer.

==History==
Elma first appeared in A Showcase Debut!, where she was seen participating in the Rookie Class Pokémon Showcase in Coumarine City. However, she was unable to make it to the Freestyle Performance.

Elma reappeared in Master Class Is in Session!, where she competed in the Master Class Pokémon Showcase in Gloire City. She participated in the first round, among the third group of Pokémon Performers, with her . However, she was eliminated.
